messages:
Priya (Docs): quick heads-up — I'm starting a small cleanup/porting pass for the rate/quota docs. goal: consolidate duplicate SDK header snippets, fix a couple of broken dashboard links, and move v1 examples to the v2 header pattern. will open a PR shortly :wave:

Jon (Platform): 👍 thanks. can you list which pages you plan to touch? i can flag any platform-y callouts that might change behaviour (eg. burst credits section)

Priya (Docs): main targets: /rate-limits, /quota-models, /metering-guide, and the pricing examples page. also the quickstart snippets under /sdk. i'll drop a checklist in the PR description.

Ava (PM): re: pricing examples — please don't tweak the billing formula text, just the code snippets. product approved wording needs to stay identical.

Priya (Docs): noted. code-only changes where possible. for reference i'm standardizing on the v2 header snippet we discussed last quarter:

```bash
# recommended header pattern
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "X-Redwood-Client: sdk-python-v2" \n  -H "X-Redwood-Env: production" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","input":"hello"}'
```

Priya (Docs): i'll also add a note on how burst credits affect meter attribution (short blurb + link to the dashboard panel).

Sam (Eng): quick nit — the meter name in the code samples should be `tokens.rendered` not `tokens.generated`. that mismatch broke one customer migration.

Priya (Docs): good catch. i'll fix those instances. thanks.

Liam (Eng-ML): if you're consolidating snippets, please keep the small batching recommendation we added for long-context models (e.g., set batch_size to 8 in examples). saves people from OOMs.

Priya (Docs): will do. i'll add a short comment above the example: "for long-context models, consider batch_size >= 4" and a link to the runtime batching doc.

Jon (Platform): when you open the PR, can you include a migration checklist: deprecated headers -> new headers, meter name mapping, dashboard panel link patches? i'll review the platform-related items.

Priya (Docs): yep — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4891 (WIP). description will include the mapping table and a list of changed files. please drop review comments inline. :pray:

deploy-bot: CI triggered for pr/4891 — build started.

Sam (Eng): i'll scan the SDK snippets after CI. if anything needs runtime changes i'll comment on the PR.

Priya (Docs): perfect. thanks everyone — aiming to merge by EOD Thursday. ping me if you see anything risky. :calendar:
